SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count"
FROM "cube_demo"."erp_invoices"
WHERE date((CASE
    WHEN typeof("issue_date") IN ('integer','real') AND "issue_date" > 100000000000
      THEN datetime("issue_date"/1000, 'unixepoch')
    WHEN typeof("issue_date") IN ('integer','real')
      THEN datetime("issue_date", 'unixepoch')
    ELSE "issue_date"
  END)) >= '2025-01-01' AND date((CASE
    WHEN typeof("issue_date") IN ('integer','real') AND "issue_date" > 100000000000
      THEN datetime("issue_date"/1000, 'unixepoch')
    WHEN typeof("issue_date") IN ('integer','real')

    ELSE "issue_date"

a10-tickets-by-month.sqlite:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', (CASE
    WHEN typeof("opened_date") IN ('integer','real') AND "opened_date" > 100000000000
      THEN datetime("opened_date"/1000, 'unixepoch')
    WHEN typeof("opened_date") IN ('integer','real')
      THEN datetime("opened_date", 'unixepoch')
    ELSE "opened_date"
  END)) AS "opened_date", COUNT(*) AS "count"
FROM "cube_demo"."support_tickets"
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', (CASE
    WHEN typeof("opened_date") IN ('integer','real') AND "opened_date" > 100000000000
      THEN datetime("opened_date"/1000, 'unixepoch')
    WHEN typeof("opened_date") IN ('integer','real')
      THEN datetime("opened_date", 'unixepoch')
    ELSE "opened_date"
  END))
ORDER BY "opened_date" ASC
LIMIT 6

b5-orders-by-month.sqlite:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', (CASE
    WHEN typeof("OrderDate") IN ('integer','real') AND "OrderDate" > 100000000000
      THEN datetime("OrderDate"/1000, 'unixepoch')
    WHEN typeof("OrderDate") IN ('integer','real')
      THEN datetime("OrderDate", 'unixepoch')
    ELSE "OrderDate"
  END)) AS "OrderDate", COUNT(*) AS "count"
FROM "Orders"
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', (CASE
    WHEN typeof("OrderDate") IN ('integer','real') AND "OrderDate" > 100000000000
      THEN datetime("OrderDate"/1000, 'unixepoch')
    WHEN typeof("OrderDate") IN ('integer','real')
      THEN datetime("OrderDate", 'unixepoch')
    ELSE "OrderDate"
  END))
ORDER BY "OrderDate" ASC
LIMIT 3

    WHEN typeof("OrderDate") IN ('integer','real') AND "OrderDate" > 100000000000
      THEN datetime("OrderDate"/1000, 'unixepoch')
    WHEN typeof("OrderDate") IN ('integer','real')
      THEN datetime("OrderDate", 'unixepoch')
    ELSE "OrderDate"
  END)) AS "minv", MAX((CASE
    WHEN typeof("OrderDate") IN ('integer','real') AND "OrderDate" > 100000000000
      THEN datetime("OrderDate"/1000, 'unixepoch')
    WHEN typeof("OrderDate") IN ('integer','real')
      THEN datetime("OrderDate", 'unixepoch')
    ELSE "OrderDate"
  END)) AS "maxv" FROM "Orders" WHERE "OrderDate" IS NOT NULL
